fields: required String, Bool, or named owned Value Object; checked acyclic closure
identity: one Entity identity field: String or recursively all-String Value Object
input: inert parent field bag; nested fields must already be snapshots owned by the exact imported Value Object provider
reconstruction: same owned-component input contract as create; not a JSON codec
validators: exact declared generated Rules; scalar parameters bind to a direct field or explicit nonempty property path through owned Value Objects
invariants: each Value Object base validator set exactly covers its authored invariant references
extensions: named additive validation; child extension requirements are not inferred by a parent
component_protocol: typescript.owned-value-component/v1; module-private membership, complete tuple equality and injective length-prefixed keys
value_equality: complete recursive typed tuple; no ambient object methods, reference equality or serialization
entity_equality: canonical identity only; validated immutable transitions cannot change identity
dependency_evidence: explicit imported provider selectors and exact emitted artifact digests in plan
